code_examples.section: ltm rule event REWRITE RESPONSE DONE
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

REWRITE_RESPONSE_DONE
       Only trigged when the REWRITE_REQUEST_DONE event calls REWRITE::post_process on.

DESCRIPTION
       An iRule event that is only trigged when the REWRITE_REQUEST_DONE event calls REWRITE::post_process on.

Examples
	when REWRITE_RESPONSE_DONE {
	  log local0. "length :: [REWRITE::payload length] ::"
	  log local0. "payload:: [REWRITE::payload] ::"
	}

	when REWRITE_RESPONSE_DONE {
	  set data [REWRITE::payload]

	  set start [string first  $data]
	  set end [string first  $data]
	  set end [expr {$end + [string length ""]}]
	  set length [expr {$end - $start}]

	  REWRITE::payload replace $start $length {Hello World}
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-10.2.1 --First introduced the event.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
